12	/-!
13	# THE DEGREE-ZERO DIVISOR FUNCTOR VALUE IS A SINGLETON OVER A FIELD
14	
15	`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZero.lean` built the object side: `DivFamZar C R π 0` is inhabited
16	for **every** test ring `R`, unconditionally, because the colength certificate at degree `0` is
17	free.  Inhabitation alone does not represent a functor.  This file supplies the other half over
18	a field test, and the answer is as strong as it can be: the value is not merely small, it has
19	**exactly one element**.
20	
21	## The argument, in one line each
22	
23	A degree-`n` certified family cuts a divisor of degree exactly `n`
24	(`DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor`), and the divisor a local-equation
25	system cuts is always **effective** (`Scheme.zero_le_coeffAt_presentationDivisor` — an
26	equation's order of vanishing is non-negative).  At `n = 0` an effective divisor of degree `0`
27	is **zero** (`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero`).  So every degree-`0` family cuts
28	the same divisor, and over a field equal presentation divisors force divisor-equality
29	(`Scheme.divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq`), which is precisely the relation `DivFam` quotients
30	by.  Finally `DivFam.exists_toZar_eq` says `toZar` is surjective over a field, carrying the
31	subsingleton from the globally certified quotient to the **locally** certified one — the actual
32	functor carrier.
33	
34	Note which direction each ingredient runs.  `deg_presentationDivisor` prices the certificate;
35	effectivity is a fact about local equations with no certificate at all; and it is only their
36	**conjunction** at `n = 0` that pins the divisor.  At `n > 0` the same two facts leave a
37	positive-degree effective divisor entirely free, which is why this argument is specific to `0`
38	and not a general uniqueness theorem in disguise.
39	
40	## Main declarations
41	
42	* `AlgebraicGeometry.presentationDivisor_eq_zero_of_isCertified_zero` — a degree-`0` certified
43	  family cuts the **zero** divisor.
44	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divEq_of_isCertified_zero` — hence any two are divisor-equal.
45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSubsingletonDivFamZero` — `DivFam C K π 0` is a subsingleton.
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instSubsingletonDivFamZarZero` — **and so is the functor carrier**
47	  `DivFamZar C K π 0`, by field surjectivity of `toZar`.
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.uniqueZeroOfField` — combining with
49	  `DivFamZar.instNonemptyDivFamZarZero`, the value is a `Unique`: exactly one degree-zero class
50	  over a field.
51	
52	## What this does and does not give the seam
53	
54	**Does**: the degree-zero divisor functor restricted to *field* tests is the one-point functor,
55	so on that subcategory it is represented by the terminal object.  That is a genuine
56	`RepresentableBy` statement about a restriction, and it is the first place in this tree where
57	the divisor functor is pinned rather than assumed.
58	
59	**Does not**: `divFunctor C π 0` is a presheaf on the **whole** slice `Over (Spec k)`, not just
60	field points, and `mixedParamChart` consumes `rep` at that full functor.  The subsingleton
61	above needs `Field K` twice — once for `divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq`, which is stated over
62	a field because a non-reduced base has divisor-inequivalent systems with equal presentation
63	divisors, and once for `DivFam.exists_toZar_eq`.  Whether `DivFamZar C R π 0` is a subsingleton
64	for a general `R` is **open and not measured here**; the inhabitation half of the previous file
65	holds for every `R`, the uniqueness half does not transfer, and I do not claim it does.
66	
67	So the honest summary is: at parameter `0` the object side is unconditional and the uniqueness
68	side is field-local.  Closing the gap between them is the general-test rung, and it is the same
69	rung `CertifiedDivisorFamily.windowGen` owes on the widened route.
70	-/
71	
72	set_option autoImplicit false

82	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

84	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
85	
86	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
87	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
88	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
89	variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
90	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
91	  [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
92	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
93	
94	/-! ## A degree-zero family cuts the zero divisor -/
95	
96	/-- **The degree-zero pin.**  A certified family of degree `0` cuts the *zero* divisor: its
97	presentation divisor is effective because orders of vanishing of an equation are non-negative,
98	and has degree `0` by the certificate, and an effective divisor of degree `≤ 0` is zero.
99	
100	Both inputs are needed and neither suffices: effectivity holds at every `n` and says nothing
101	about which divisor; the degree identity holds at every `n` and pins nothing until the degree is
102	`0`. -/
103	theorem presentationDivisor_eq_zero_of_isCertified_zero
104	    {d : (relCurve C K).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C K pi d)
105	    (hc : A.IsCertified 0) :
106	    Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation = 0 := by
107	  refine Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_zero_of_deg_le_zero K (fun x => ?_) ?_
108	  · exact Scheme.zero_le_coeffAt_presentationDivisor K d x.2
109	  · rw [DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified.deg_presentationDivisor (A := A) hc]
110	    norm_num
111	
112	/-- **Any two degree-zero certified families are divisor-equal**, since both cut the zero
113	divisor and over a field equal presentation divisors force `DivEq`. -/
114	theorem divEq_of_isCertified_zero
115	    {d d' : (relCurve C K).LocalEquations}
116	    (A : DivisorAdaptation C K pi d) (hc : A.IsCertified 0)
117	    (A' : DivisorAdaptation C K pi d') (hc' : A'.IsCertified 0) :
118	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d' :=
119	  Scheme.divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq K
120	    ((presentationDivisor_eq_zero_of_isCertified_zero A hc).trans
121	      (presentationDivisor_eq_zero_of_isCertified_zero A' hc').symm)
122	
123	/-! ## The quotients are subsingletons -/
124	
125	/-- **`DivFam C K π 0` has at most one element.**  `divFamSetoid` relates two families exactly
126	when their systems are divisor-equal, and `divEq_of_isCertified_zero` says that always holds at
127	degree `0`. -/
128	instance instSubsingletonDivFamZero : Subsingleton (DivFam C K pi 0) := by
129	  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
130	  induction x using Quotient.ind with | _ F =>
131	  induction y using Quotient.ind with | _ G =>
132	  exact Quotient.sound (divEq_of_isCertified_zero F.adaptation F.certified
133	    G.adaptation G.certified)
134	
135	/-- **And so does the functor carrier `DivFamZar C K π 0`.**  Over a field `toZar` is surjective
136	(`DivFam.exists_toZar_eq`), so the subsingleton transports from the globally certified quotient
137	to the locally certified one — which is the type `divFunctor C π 0` actually takes as its value
138	at `Spec K`. -/
139	instance instSubsingletonDivFamZarZero : Subsingleton (DivFamZar C K pi 0) := by
140	  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
141	  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := DivFam.exists_toZar_eq (C := C) (K := K) (π := pi) (n := 0) x
142	  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := DivFam.exists_toZar_eq (C := C) (K := K) (π := pi) (n := 0) y
143	  rw [← hG, ← hH, Subsingleton.elim G H]
144	
145	/-- **EXACTLY ONE degree-zero divisor class over a field**: `Nonempty` from the unconditional
146	`DivFamZar.trivZar`, `Subsingleton` from the pin above. -/
147	@[reducible] noncomputable def DivFamZar.uniqueZeroOfField : Unique (DivFamZar C K pi 0) :=
148	  uniqueOfSubsingleton (DivFamZar.trivZar C K pi)
149	
150	end AlgebraicGeometry

9	/-!
10	# THE DEGREE-ZERO DIVISOR FUNCTOR IS INHABITED, UNCONDITIONALLY
11	
12	`DivFamZar C R π n` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZar.lean:235`) is the value of the divisor functor
13	that the whole Pic⁰ representability seam consumes, through
14	`rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D` in `mixedParamChart`
15	(`Picard/Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree.lean:64`).  Its own header names the open question:
16	
17	> it does not produce the representations. `mixedParamChart` takes `rep i` as a hypothesis, one
18	> per parameter, and the divisor-representability lane supplies `divFunctor C π g` — a single
19	> parameter.
20	
21	Every landed route to `rep` targets `n = g` through the chart-typed classifier and is gated on
22	U2 / the G-4 certificate (`AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.divrep.u2`).  **Nobody had asked what
23	happens at `n = 0`**, and this file answers it: at parameter `0` the entire certificate
24	apparatus is free.
25	
26	## What is proved here, and why the certificate collapses
27	
28	The colength certificate `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified n` (`Picard/DivisorFamily.lean:426`)
29	asks for finite projective chart-local colengths, a finite projective glued colength module of
30	constant fibre rank `n` at every prime, and two flat-cokernel clauses.  On the **trivial**
31	local-equation system — cover `⊤`, equation `1` everywhere, which is
32	`Scheme.LocalEquations.unitEquations` up to the `IsIntegral` binder that is not needed here —
33	every colength module is `Γ(…) ⧸ (1) = 0`.  A zero module is free, hence finite, projective and
34	flat; and `Module.rankAtStalk` of a subsingleton is `0`, which **is** the `n = 0` clause.  So
35	all seven fields close with no hypothesis on the curve beyond what `relCurve` needs to exist.
36	
37	The whole content is that `n = 0` is the degree at which the rank clause asks for *nothing*.
38	Over a **nontrivial** test ring the same construction fails at `n > 0` on exactly one field,
39	`rankAtStalk_glued`, and that is the honest boundary.  The nontriviality qualifier is not
40	decoration: over the zero ring `PrimeSpectrum R` is empty, so the rank clause is vacuous at
41	*every* `n` and `trivAdapt` is certified in every degree.  An earlier draft stated the boundary
42	without it and was refuted by that case in a fresh-context audit.
43	
44	## Main declarations
45	
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.trivEqns` — the trivial system, with no `IsIntegral` binder.
47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.trivAdapt` — its one-piece-per-chart adaptation.
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.isCertified_trivAdapt` — **the degree-zero certificate, free**.
49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.trivFam` — an unconditional `CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π 0`.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.trivZar` — hence `DivFamZar C R π 0` is inhabited, and
51	  `instInhabitedDivFamZarZero` registers it.
52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_trivZar` — **the trivial class is base-change invariant
53	  along an arbitrary `k`-algebra map**, with no tower hypotheses at all.
54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.trivSection` / `divFunctor_obj_nonempty_zero` — hence the
55	  degree-zero divisor functor has a point over **every** test object of the slice, not only
56	  affine ones.
57	
58	TWO CORRECTIONS TO EARLIER DRAFTS OF THIS LIST, both found by a fresh-context audit of my own
59	work and both recorded rather than quietly fixed.
60	
61	*First*, an earlier draft named `divFunctor_obj_nonempty_zero` while no such declaration
62	existed — the `cited-names-need-check-not-grep` failure, in the summary a reader hits first.
63	*Second*, and this is the more interesting one: the commit that retracted it replaced the
64	citation with a **hedge that was itself false**.  It said the general-test section was blocked
65	because `Over.resAlgHom T h` must agree with `algebraMap` and that is not `rfl`.  That reads the
66	dependency backwards.  `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` *defines* the algebra structure it uses as
67	`φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean`), so the agreement holds **by
68	construction at every `φ`** — the tower hypotheses I thought I needed can be manufactured
69	locally with `letI`/`haveI`, and `mapAlgHom_trivZar` below carries none of them.  The section is
70	landed above.  A hedge standing in for an unattempted check is worse than no note; a hedge that
71	misreads the consumer's own definition schedules work that is minutes away.
72	
73	## What this does NOT do
74	
75	It does not represent `divFunctor C π 0`: a point of every value is not a natural bijection
76	with a scheme's points.  Representability at `0` additionally needs *uniqueness* — that the
77	degree-zero value is a subsingleton — which is a separate statement and is not proved here.
78	`Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroUnique.lean` takes that up.
79	
80	Nor does it give the seam an atlas: `mixedParamChart` at `nn i = 0` also needs a chart index
81	`Z i` of degree `m·d₁ − 0` and the two seam antecedents, none of which this file touches.
82	What it removes is the standing sentence that `rep` has **no** producer at **any** parameter —
83	the object side at parameter `0` is now built and axiom-clean.
84	-/
85

104	/-! ## Zero modules are finite, projective and flat
105	
106	Three one-line consequences of `Module.Free.of_subsingleton`, stated because the certificate
107	needs them at four different module expressions and `infer_instance` cannot see
108	`Subsingleton` through the quotient spellings. -/
109	
110	section ZeroModule
111	
112	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
113	
114	theorem finite_of_subsingleton (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Subsingleton M] :
115	    Module.Finite R M :=
116	  haveI := Module.Free.of_subsingleton R M
117	  Module.Finite.of_finite
118	
119	theorem projective_of_subsingleton (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
120	    [Subsingleton M] : Module.Projective R M :=
121	  haveI := Module.Free.of_subsingleton R M
122	  Module.Projective.of_free
123	
124	theorem flat_of_subsingleton (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Subsingleton M] :
125	    Module.Flat R M :=
126	  haveI := Module.Free.of_subsingleton R M
127	  inferInstance
128	
129	end ZeroModule
130	
131	/-! ## The trivial local-equation system and its adaptation -/
132	
133	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
134	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
135	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom pi]
136	
137	/-- **The trivial local-equation system on the relative curve**: the constant equation `1` on
138	the top cover.
139	
140	This is `Scheme.LocalEquations.unitEquations` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyBackward.lean:51`)
141	transcribed *without* its `[IsIntegral X]` binder — that lemma's section carries the binder for
142	its `presentationDivisor` statements, and `relCurve C R` over a general test ring `R` is not
143	integral, so the landed name is not applicable at the site this file needs.  The two `Prop`
144	fields need only that `1` is a unit: `regular` is `map_one` plus `one_mem`, and the overlap
145	ratio is `1`. -/
146	noncomputable def trivEqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations where
147	  cover := ⊤
148	  eqn := fun _ => 1
149	  regular := fun _ y _ => by rw [map_one]; exact one_mem _
150	  ratio_isUnit := fun _ _ => ⟨1, by simp⟩
151	
152	@[simp]
153	lemma trivEqns_eqn (y : relCurve C R) : (trivEqns C R).eqn y = 1 := rfl
154	
155	@[simp]
156	lemma trivEqns_cover : (trivEqns C R).cover = ⊤ := rfl
157	
158	/-- **The one-piece-per-chart cover datum**: one basic open per pinned chart, cut out by the
159	unit `1`, with partition coefficient `1`.  The basic open of `1` is the whole chart, so this is
160	the coarsest legal `FinCoverData` and the partition witnesses are `mul_one`. -/
161	noncomputable def trivCover : FinCoverData C R pi where
162	  m₀ := 1
163	  m₁ := 1
164	  h₀ := fun _ => 1
165	  h₁ := fun _ => 1
166	  a₀ := fun _ => 1
167	  a₁ := fun _ => 1
168	  partition₀ := by simp
169	  partition₁ := by simp
170	
171	/-- **The trivial adaptation**: equation `1` on each of the two pieces.  The refinement clause
172	`eqn_rel` holds with unit `1`, because both sides restrict `1` to the same overlap. -/
173	noncomputable def trivAdapt : DivisorAdaptation C R pi (trivEqns C R) where
174	  toFinCoverData := trivCover C R pi
175	  eqn := fun _ => 1
176	  eqn_rel := fun _ _ => ⟨1, by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul, trivEqns_eqn, map_one, map_one]⟩
177	
178	@[simp]
179	lemma trivAdapt_eqn (j : (trivAdapt C R pi).index) : (trivAdapt C R pi).eqn j = 1 := rfl
180	
181	/-! ## Every colength module of the trivial adaptation vanishes
182	
183	This is the whole reason the degree-zero certificate is free: the colength modules are
184	quotients by the ideal generated by the *equation*, and the equation is a unit. -/
185	
186	instance subsingleton_trivAdapt_colength (j : (trivAdapt C R pi).index) :
187	    Subsingleton ((trivAdapt C R pi).colength j) := by
188	  change Subsingleton (_ ⧸ Ideal.span {(trivAdapt C R pi).eqn j})
189	  rw [trivAdapt_eqn, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
190	  exact Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl
191	
192	/-- The overlap colength modules vanish too.  Here the ideal is the *symmetric* span of the two
193	restricted equations, so the `span_singleton_one` shortcut does not apply directly: instead the
194	first generator restricts to `1`, and an ideal containing `1` is `⊤`. -/
195	instance subsingleton_trivAdapt_ovlColength (i j : (trivAdapt C R pi).index) :
196	    Subsingleton ((trivAdapt C R pi).ovlColength i j) := by
197	  change Subsingleton (_ ⧸ (trivAdapt C R pi).ovlIdeal i j)
198	  refine Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr (le_antisymm le_top fun x _ => ?_)
199	  have h : (1 : Γ(relCurve C R, (trivAdapt C R pi).pieces i ⊓ (trivAdapt C R pi).pieces j))
200	      ∈ (trivAdapt C R pi).ovlIdeal i j := by
201	    have hm : relResAlgHom C R
202	        (inf_le_left : (trivAdapt C R pi).pieces i ⊓ (trivAdapt C R pi).pieces j
203	          ≤ (trivAdapt C R pi).pieces i) ((trivAdapt C R pi).eqn i)
204	        ∈ (trivAdapt C R pi).ovlIdeal i j :=
205	      Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
206	    rwa [trivAdapt_eqn, relResAlgHom_apply, map_one] at hm
207	  simpa using Ideal.mul_mem_left _ x h
208	
209	instance subsingleton_trivAdapt_chartProd : Subsingleton ((trivAdapt C R pi).chartProd) :=
210	  ⟨fun _ _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
211	
212	instance subsingleton_trivAdapt_ovlProd : Subsingleton ((trivAdapt C R pi).ovlProd) :=
213	  ⟨fun _ _ => funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
214	
215	instance subsingleton_trivAdapt_glued : Subsingleton ((trivAdapt C R pi).Glued) :=
216	  ⟨fun _ _ => Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
217	
218	/-! ## The degree-zero certificate -/
219	
220	/-- **THE DEGREE-ZERO COLENGTH CERTIFICATE IS FREE.**
221	
222	All seven fields of `DivisorAdaptation.IsCertified 0` hold for the trivial adaptation with **no
223	hypothesis** beyond those needed for `relCurve C R` to exist: the four finiteness/projectivity
224	clauses and the two flat-cokernel clauses are the zero module being free, and the rank clause
225	`rankAtStalk_glued` asks for rank `0`, which `Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_of_subsingleton`
226	supplies.
227	
228	**The boundary is that last field and nothing else.**  Over a nontrivial test ring `trivAdapt`
229	still satisfies the other six clauses at `n > 0` and fails this one, so `0` is not an arbitrary
230	choice of small parameter — it is the unique degree at which the rank clause is satisfiable
231	here.  Over the zero ring there are no primes and every degree is certified, which is why the
232	nontriviality qualifier belongs in the statement of the boundary rather than in a footnote. -/
233	theorem isCertified_trivAdapt : (trivAdapt C R pi).IsCertified 0 where
234	  finite_colength := fun _ => finite_of_subsingleton R _
235	  projective_colength := fun _ => projective_of_subsingleton R _
236	  finite_glued := finite_of_subsingleton R _
237	  projective_glued := projective_of_subsingleton R _
238	  rankAtStalk_glued := fun p => by
239	    have h : Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (trivAdapt C R pi).Glued = 0 :=
240	      Module.rankAtStalk_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
241	    rw [h]
242	    rfl
243	  flat_coker_incl := flat_of_subsingleton R _
244	  flat_coker_diff := flat_of_subsingleton R _
245	
246	/-- **An unconditional degree-zero certified divisor family.**  The first inhabitant of
247	`CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n` at any parameter that is not gated on the DD-R certificate
248	tower. -/
249	noncomputable def trivFam : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R pi 0 where
250	  eqns := trivEqns C R
251	  adaptation := trivAdapt C R pi
252	  certified := isCertified_trivAdapt C R pi
253	
254	/-- **`DivFamZar C R π 0` is inhabited**, via `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified`
255	(a global certificate is a local one, at the trivial cover `g = ![1]`). -/
256	noncomputable def trivZar : DivFamZar C R pi 0 :=
257	  DivFamZar.mk (trivFam C R pi).eqns (trivFam C R pi).isLocallyCertified
258	
259	instance instNonemptyDivFamZarZero : Nonempty (DivFamZar C R pi 0) :=
260	  ⟨trivZar C R pi⟩
261	
262	/-! ## The trivial class is base-change invariant, hence a GENERAL-TEST section
263	
264	`divFamZar C π n T` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean:187`) is a compatible family of
265	`DivFamZar` classes over the affine opens of `T.left`.  Taking the trivial class at every
266	affine open gives such a family precisely because base change sends the trivial class to the
267	trivial class — and it does, for the cheapest possible reason: the pulled system's equation is
268	the *restriction of* `1`, and restriction is a ring hom. -/

270	section BaseChange

276	theorem mapAlg_trivZar [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A'] :
277	    DivFamZar.mapAlg (C := C) (π := pi) (R := A) A' 0 (trivZar C A pi) = trivZar C A' pi := by
278	  refine DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ?_
279	  refine ⟨(trivEqns C A').cover, fun _ => le_top, le_rfl, fun _ => ⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
280	  rw [Units.val_one, one_mul, Scheme.LocalEquations.pullback_eqn]
281	  change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) (1 : _))
282	      = (CommRingCat.Hom.hom _) (1 : _)
283	  rw [map_one, map_one, map_one]
284	
285	/-- **Base change preserves the trivial class along an ARBITRARY `k`-algebra map** — no
286	`[Algebra A A']`, no `[IsScalarTower]`, no agreement hypothesis.
287	
288	This is the form the vehicle's compatibility clause consumes, and the reason it needs nothing:
289	`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` *defines* the algebra structure it uses as `phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra`, so
290	the tower data can be manufactured locally from `phi` itself and the agreement with
291	`algebraMap` is `rfl` by construction.  An earlier version of this file carried all three
292	hypotheses and hedged that the general-test section was blocked on the agreement; see the

295	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (C := C) (π := pi) (n := 0) phi (trivZar C A pi) = trivZar C A' pi := by
296	  letI : Algebra A A' := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
297	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (phi.commutes a).symm
298	  exact mapAlg_trivZar C pi
299	
300	end BaseChange

303	
304	`divFamZar C π n T` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyZarVehicle.lean`) is a compatible family of `DivFamZar`
305	classes over the affine opens of `T.left`.  Base-change invariance in the hypothesis-free form
306	above makes the constant-trivial family compatible in one line, so the degree-zero divisor
307	functor has a point over **every** test object of the slice. -/
308	
309	/-- **The trivial section of the degree-zero divisor functor at an arbitrary test.** -/
310	noncomputable def trivSection (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : divFamZar C pi 0 T :=
311	  ⟨fun _ => trivZar C _ pi, fun _ _ h => mapAlgHom_trivZar C pi (Over.resAlgHom T h)⟩
312	
313	/-- **The degree-zero divisor functor has a point over every test object.**  Worth stating
314	separately from `instNonemptyDivFamZarZero`: that one is affine-local, this is the functor value
315	on the whole slice. -/
316	theorem divFunctor_obj_nonempty_zero (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
317	    Nonempty ((divFunctor C pi 0).obj T) :=
318	  ⟨trivSection C pi T.unop⟩
319	
320	end DivFamZar
321	
322	end AlgebraicGeometry

summary: "DEG-ZERO. ADVANCED SUBSTANTIALLY, NO SEAM ANTECEDENT CLOSED. Released (pic-c,\
  \ run 0092).\n\nWHAT LANDED, all sorry-free, lake build EXIT=0 (8782 jobs), both\
  \ modules rooted:\n Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZero.lean -- THE DEGREE-ZERO CERTIFICATE\
  \ IS FREE. On the trivial system (cover top, eqn 1) every colength module is Gamma/(1)\
  \ = 0; a zero module is free hence finite/projective/flat, and rankAtStalk of a\
  \ subsingleton is 0, which IS the n = 0 clause. All seven fields of IsCertified\
  \ 0 close with NO hypothesis beyond what relCurve needs to exist. Gives CertifiedDivisorFamily\
  \ C R pi 0 and trivZar : DivFamZar C R pi 0 for EVERY test ring R, axiom-clean [propext,\
  \ Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Plus mapAlg_trivZar / mapAlgHom_trivZar: the trivial\
  \ class is BASE-CHANGE INVARIANT.\n Picard/DivisorFamilyDegreeZeroUnique.lean --\
  \ AND OVER A FIELD THE VALUE IS A SINGLETON. A degree-n family cuts a divisor of\
  \ degree exactly n; the divisor a local-equation system cuts is always EFFECTIVE\
  \ (no certificate needed); at n = 0 an effective degree-0 divisor is ZERO. So all\
  \ degree-0 families cut the same divisor, DivEq follows over a field, and DivFam.exists_toZar_eq\
  \ carries the subsingleton to the FUNCTOR CARRIER DivFamZar. DivFamZar.uniqueZeroOfField\
  \ : Unique.\n\nWHY 0 IS NOT AN ARBITRARY SMALL PARAMETER, and this is the file's\
  \ own stated boundary: rankAtStalk_glued is the ONE field of the seven that fails\
  \ at n > 0 for this adaptation. 0 is the unique degree at which the rank clause\
  \ is vacuous. Symmetrically, effectivity + the degree identity pin nothing at n\
  \ > 0, so the uniqueness argument is also specific to 0 and is not a general theorem\
  \ in disguise.\n\nWHAT IS OPEN, stated plainly. This is NOT yet (divFunctor C pi\
  \ 0).RepresentableBy. Two gaps, in order:\n (1) THE GENERAL-TEST SECTION. divFamZar\
  \ C pi 0 T for arbitrary T needs the constant-trivial family to satisfy the vehicle's\
  \ compatibility clause; mapAlgHom_trivZar is the right transport law but Over.resAlgHom\
  \ T h = algebraMap is NOT rfl on the restriction -- it needs tower instances nobody\
  \ has built. I attempted this and it is recorded as attempted, not as done.\n (2)\
  \ GENERAL-R UNIQUENESS. The subsingleton needs Field K TWICE: for divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq\
  \ (a non-reduced base has divisor-inequivalent systems with equal presentation divisors)\
  \ and for exists_toZar_eq. Whether DivFamZar C R pi 0 is a subsingleton at general\
  \ R is UNMEASURED. Inhabitation transfers to every R; uniqueness does not.\n\nAND\
  \ THE SEAM-LEVEL CAVEAT a consumer must read: even a full rep at nn i = 0 does not\
  \ feed mixedParamChart alone -- it still needs a legal chart index Z i of degree\
  \ m*d1 - 0 and BOTH seam antecedents at that index. This row buys the rep slot's\
  \ object side at one parameter, nothing above it.\n\nA DOCSTRING CITATION I RETRACTED\
  \ IN PLACE (fc9dda7cbe): the first commit's main-declarations list named divFunctor_obj_nonempty_zero,\
  \ which does not exist and which I never proved. Corrected at its site with the\
  \ reason it stops."

  Spec k) makes an open''s inclusion quasi-compact, so every open is compact. compactSpace_of_representableBy:

  binder is IDLE (statement compiles without it; glueData does not depend on coverage).
  So the compactness half is coverage-FREE (I-1430).

  project. Four of my own claims were refuted by a fresh-context audit and repaired
